# DXF Viewer

> Free browser-based DXF file viewer and converter. View 2D and 3D DXF drawings, manage layers, and export to PDF, SVG, and PNG — all client-side with no server uploads.

## What This Tool Does

DXF Viewer is a web application that renders DXF (Drawing Exchange Format) files in the browser using Three.js and WebGL. It parses DXF files client-side and displays them as interactive 3D or 2D scenes. Users can toggle layers, switch between 3D orbital and 2D orthographic views, and export their drawings to multiple formats.

All file processing happens in the browser. No files are uploaded to any server. No account or signup is required.

## URL

https://udqy.github.io/dxfv/

## Features

- **3D/2D View Toggle**: Switch between 3D perspective (orbit, pan, zoom) and 2D orthographic top-down view.
- **Layer Management**: Show/hide individual layers from the DXF file.
- **Export to PDF**: Convert DXF drawings to PDF documents via the browser print dialog.
- **Export to SVG**: Export the current view as a scalable vector graphic.
- **Export to PNG**: Export as a high-resolution raster image, with optional transparent background.
- **Direct Print**: Print drawings directly from the browser.
- **ViewCube**: Click cube faces to snap to standard orthographic views (top, front, left, right, back, bottom).
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: V (toggle view), L (layers), E (export), F/R (fit/reset), H (help).
- **Touch Gestures**: Mobile-friendly with pinch-to-zoom and drag-to-rotate.
- **Drag and Drop**: Drop a .dxf file onto the page to open it.

## Technical Details

- Built with Vite, Three.js, and dxf-parser
- Renders using WebGL via Three.js
- Supports lines, polylines, circles, arcs, ellipses, splines, 3D faces, points, and text entities from DXF files
- Measurements displayed in the DXF file's native units
- No backend — everything runs in the browser
- Deployed on GitHub Pages

## Supported DXF Entities

- LINE
- LWPOLYLINE / POLYLINE
- CIRCLE
- ARC
- ELLIPSE
- SPLINE
- 3DFACE
- POINT
- TEXT / MTEXT
- INSERT (block references)
- DIMENSION

## Use Cases

- Engineers and manufacturers reviewing technical drawings
- Architects examining building plans and layouts
- Students studying CAD without needing AutoCAD installed
- Hobbyists viewing 3D printing files, CNC plans, and DIY project designs
- Anyone who needs a quick DXF to PDF/SVG/PNG conversion without installing software

## Privacy

Files are processed entirely in the browser using JavaScript. No data is sent to any server. The only external request is to Google Analytics for anonymous usage statistics.
